name: separable_12block
description: Twelve 2x2 PSD blocks (m=12), separable. For c=1..12 block c has cost A_c=[[c,1],[1,0]] and its own trace constraint tr(X_c)=1. Separable => opt = sum_c lambda_max(A_c) = sum_{c=1}^{12} (c/2 + sqrt(c^2/4 + 1)). Each X_c* is the rank-1 projector onto its top eigenvector (boundary). Large-m Schur ASSEMBLY/storage stressor with 12 PSD blocks (the Schur is block-diagonal: one 1x1 block per constraint).
reference_method: Closed form: lambda_max([[c,1],[1,0]]) = c/2 + sqrt(c^2/4 + 1); opt = sum over c=1..12. Cross-checked in mpmath 1.3.0 (closed-form sum vs per-block numeric eigensolve, diff 0 at 40 digits).
